plainTranslation: Two strong wills grinding against each other. Real attraction laced with real conflict - competition, irritation, the urge to dominate. Failure mode: the relationship runs on fighting and the make-up becomes the point. Channel the heat into something built together; a constant power struggle is a cost, not chemistry.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Your drives keep clashing, wanting to move different ways at once. Friction, competition, and heat. Aim the fight at a shared task, not at each other.
tension: The deeper challenge is that conflict can start to feel like the main source of connection. The arguments create intensity. The intensity creates engagement. And over time, it becomes easy to confuse being activated with being understood. You may tell yourself the relationship is passionate when what you are actually feeling is constant friction.
advice: The opportunity here is growth. This person has a way of bringing your triggers to the surface, just as you bring theirs to the surface. While that can be uncomfortable, it also gives you valuable insight into how you handle anger, defensiveness, and control. The more willing you are to stay curious instead of trying to win, the more this connection can teach you about yourself and how you show up in conflict.
summaryShort: Your drives keep clashing, wanting to move different ways at once.
